TPO Single Print Scalp
Research report · NQ 15-minute · prepared 2026-09-05 · branch claude/quant-trading-strategy-research-y1ind1

Volume profile, TPO, EMA and ATR features on the 07:00–11:00 Donchian scalp

Forty-five causal features tested as entry filters, take-profit levels and stop variables on a coin-flip breakout base. One condition survived every gate: a prior-session TPO single print within 3 ATR above the close. Everything the brief named by hand — EMA200 as support, the EMA 13/48 cross, profile levels as targets, ATR-scaled stops — failed its matched control. This document is written for a second quant to audit and to decide what to do next.

1. What the specialist needs to know first

  • Data. NQ continuous futures, 1-minute bars 2022-12-26 to 2025-12-12 (70,685 15-minute bars), New York clock, extended hours. Price levels are synthetic (ratio to the real index decays 1.25 → 1.02 over the sample), so returns, R and ATR units are trustworthy and dollar figures are inflated ~12% early. Bid/ask is not in the feed; spread is assumed.
  • Blocks. Research = first 65% of sessions, to 2024-11-27. Locked = 2024-11-27 to 2025-12-12, read exactly once, after every choice was fixed. Nothing after 2025-12-12 exists in the file.
  • Costs. MNQ: $0.72 commission per side plus one tick of slippage per side, charged inside the walker on every fill. One contract, no compounding, results in percent of entry price.
  • Base strategy (frozen before this study). Long only. Donchian 10-bar entry (high above the prior 10-bar high, fill at the next open), 10-bar channel exit, 3.19 × ATR(14, EMA of true range) stop anchored at the fill, 2.3 × ATR target, hard cap 230 minutes, entries 07:00–11:00 New York, one position at a time. It is the surviving finalist of a 3,600-trial Optuna search under those constraints (docs/ib/STUDY_BAYESOPT_SCALP.md) and had already been shown to clear a random entry in the same window on both blocks (locked p 0.040). A 38-condition indicator pool had already failed to raise its locked PF (docs/ib/STUDY_SCALP_FILTERS.md): best in-sample lift +12%, the only BH survivor (ADX ≥ 20) inverted out of sample.
  • Discipline. Every feature passed a truncation audit (recompute on history ending at bar i, value at i must match) and the volume-profile module's own leakage check. Base rates of every condition were measured on the trigger's own bars before any P&L. Every entry condition was scored against 250 random filters keeping the same number of signal bars; every level target against 200 random targets drawn from its own distance distribution; the stop axis reported in %/trade, R and total-at-one-unit with drawdown because those three disagree on this branch. 152 things were looked at on research before the locked block was opened.

It decays across the split (1.446 → 1.382), which is the shape an edge should have; it is positive in every calendar year (2023 PF 1.52, 2024 1.43, 2025 1.33 against the base's 1.24 / 1.14 / 1.07); it earns more total money on half the trades. Sharpe here is annualised from daily sums over every trading day, zero-filled on days that did not trade.

3. The mechanism

Inside the condition the mean MAE is 3.69 ATR against 4.44 outside, with MFE unchanged (4.11 / 4.06). The target is reached 50% of the time against 47%, the stop 45% against 49%. The reading is auction-theory: a single print marks a price zone the prior session traversed inside one letter, i.e. no acceptance, and a breakout heading into it meets less overhead supply. The only strong correlate of the single-print distance is the distance to the prior session's high (ρ −0.49), which is geometry, and the drop-one in §5 shows that geometry is not the carrier.

The 3 ATR ceiling is doing real work and it was chosen on research; the locked ladder reproduces the shape (2–4 ATR the plateau) but the specialist should treat 3.0 as one rung of a 2–4 plateau, not a constant.

5. Drop-one: is it the single print or "below yesterday's high"?

A prior-session single print above the close is inside yesterday's range, so the condition co-selects close below the prior RTH high 100% of the time. That is the inverse of a gate this branch shipped elsewhere (STUDY_V17), so it had to be separated.

Every structural stop under a profile level is at or below the fixed multiple it falls back to, because at this geometry it mostly is the fallback (median risk 3.19 in every structural row). 6d. Feature correlation on the signal bars

7. Implementation and parity

  • Order model. Signal on a closed 15m bar; fill at the next bar's open plus one tick; stop = fill − 3.19 ATR(signal bar), target = fill + 2.3 ATR, both live from the fill bar; channel exit = 10-bar low, capped at the prior close; stop and target in the same bar resolve as a stop. That ambiguous case is 2.25% of base trades and 2.98% of gated trades, so the tie-break is not what makes the number. A per-bar-stop / per-bar-target walker (vp_tpo.walk_tp) reproduces the engine exactly on 1,154 trades and is what the level targets and variable stops ran through.
  • Pine. pine/inst/VP_TPO_SCALP_strategy.pine builds the TPO profile from the chart's own bars (30-minute letters, 2.5-point bins on an absolute grid, frozen at 16:00 New York or at the next RTH open if the 16:00 bar is missing). A bar-by-bar Python transliteration of its arrays agrees with the research feature on 100.00% of 70,685 bars for the single print, POC, VAH, VAL and IB high, and the gate agrees on 100.000% (31,151 true bars both ways). The bracket is placed with the entry so the fill bar is never naked.
  • Two defects the audits caught before any number was read. (1) Prior-session values were assigned only on days that already had RTH bars, so a pre-open bar read differently under truncation (8 of 12 probes failed). (2) Early-close sessions (13:00 closes, ten in the sample) were never frozen because their last bar was the day's last bar; the next Monday read Wednesday's profile. Found by the Pine parity diff at 99.4%.
  • Files. research/inst/vp_tpo.py (features, audit, walker), run_vp_scalp.py (battery), run_vp_scalp2.py (ladder, co-selection, mechanism, years, bootstrap), run_vp_scalp3.py (drop-one), vp_tpo_parity.py, outputs in results/inst/vp_scalp*.txt, trade log with the gate flag per trade in results/inst/vp_scalp_trades.csv, study in docs/ib/STUDY_VP_TPO_SCALP.md.

8. Caveats that stay attached

  • One survivor of 43 at BH q 0.10 (6 at p ≤ 0.05 against 2.1 expected), on one market and one geometry. The branch has seen five perfect research plateaus fail out of sample; one locked read is one replication.
  • Locked n = 187. Day-block bootstrap P(mean ≤ 0) = 0.056, 95% CI [−0.012, +0.122] %/trade. It clears its matched control (p 0.016) and does not quite clear zero. Those are two different questions and both are reported.
  • Drawdown. Realised locked 4.7% of price; permutation places it at the 45th percentile of its own reshuffles; MC p95 10.5%, p99 13.1% (2.8× realised). At one MNQ near 20,000 that is roughly $5,200. Size for the p99.
  • Sample regime. NQ rose 89% over the file; the strategy is long-only; the short mirror was not tested.
  • Execution. Spread is assumed (no bid/ask in the feed). The base survives 2× the assumed spread on this branch's earlier read; the gated version has not been re-stressed.
  • Untested robustness axes. Bin size (2.5 points) and letter length (30 minutes) were fixed by convention, never swept. The 15-minute chart is the only timeframe tested.

9. Decisions for the specialist

These are the calls that would move the result, in the order I would take them. None was run, so each is a genuinely open question.

  1. Cross-market read of the TPO half. US100 and US30 exist here as 15-minute feeds (nine and eight years, 2016–2025, including 2018, COVID and the 2022 bear) and the TPO profile needs only 15-minute bars. Freeze the rule exactly as shipped, run it on both, and read their locked blocks once. A level feature that works on the Nasdaq only is a regime; one that holds on the Dow is a mechanism. This is the single most informative thing left.
  2. Robustness of the profile construction. Sweep bin size (1, 2.5, 5, 10 points and an ATR-scaled bin) and letter length (15, 30, 60 minutes) on research only. If the single-print condition needs 2.5-point bins to work, it is an artefact of resolution; if it survives 5 and 10, it is a structural feature.
  3. Widen the sample rather than the pool. The base rate of the condition is 37% and its lift is 0.91, so it is not starved. The bootstrap at n = 187 is the binding constraint; another 12 months of forward data (post 2025-12-12) would settle P(mean ≤ 0) faster than any further filter search. Recommend paper or minimum-size forward trading with the trade log format in §7 and a pre-registered stopping rule (e.g. abandon if the forward PF over 100 trades falls below 1.0).
  4. Interaction with value area. The post-hoc split "below prior VAH and single print above" reads 1.51 research / 1.77 locked on n 116, and "above VAH and single print above" reads 0.89 locked. If the specialist wants to pursue it, pre-register it and read it on US100/US30, never again on NQ's locked block, which is now spent for this family.
  5. Short side. The mirrored condition (single print within 3 ATR below after a downside breakout) is a two-line change on the feature module. Expect it to fail on this sample's drift; it is still the cheapest falsification available.
  6. Do not spend effort on: the EMA200 support reading, any bullish EMA 13/48 reading, profile levels as targets, structural stops, or a tighter stop. All four axes were swept and the marginals point the other way.
